ability.name: P0 - Current Privilege State Check
ability.description: Check current user and groups to determine if privilege escalation is needed, operating purely read-only to stdout.

rationale: Per the Master Router revision, we must run P0 (Current Privilege State Check) as a standalone phase first and avoid bundling it with P1. Furthermore, per Evaluator retry feedback, the P0 check must be completely read-only with no disk writes or file creation. Therefore, the command runs purely to stdout with error handling wrapped natively.
